label: Market Close
headline: S&P -0.4%, Russell -1.7%, 10y 5.10% +10bp, Brent $95.77, Cerebras +18% after hours
stance: Yields jumped on Fed hike bets and a second weak auction; stocks gave up midday gains in the last hour. Nvidia closed -4.3% on Huang's exit.

scorecard.actual: Nvidia fell 14.3% at the open, closed -4.3%. Nasdaq 100 closed -0.3%.

scorecard.call: Morning: a low jobless claims number backs the December hike.
scorecard.actual: Claims 200K vs 195K expected (8:30). The 10y still rose 10.5bp to 5.10%.

scorecard.call: Morning: soft 30y demand would push long yields above 5.3%.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Biggest one-day jump in yields since 2022 (5:16pm reports). Hammack said policy must move to restrictive.
$25bn 30y: 2.36x cover vs 2.44x average, dealers 11.39% vs 9.49%. Second weak long auction in two days.
Brent hit $96 at 12:30pm after Trump said the US needs no Iran deal. Iran reported strikes on Sirik at 2:51pm.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Nasdaq 100 turned positive by 1:16pm, then indices gave up gains in the final hour.
Russell 2000 -1.7%, worst of the majors on the day yields jumped.
Energy +1.5%, the only sector up more than 0.1%. Materials -1.3%, communication services -1.0%.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: LQD -0.9% vs HYG -0.5% at the close. Investment grade duration took the bigger loss.

items.head: Cerebras +17.7% after hours on raised outlook
items.body: Q3 cloud revenue +265%. Raised 2026 outlook, sees 2027 revenue tripling, $26bn backlog, new Microsoft deal. Shares +17.7% at 6:43pm ET.

items.head: Cisco +0.2% after hours on beat and raise
items.body: Record revenue $18.5bn, +24%; non-GAAP EPS $1.40. Raised FY27 view; AI infrastructure revenue to double. Shares +0.2% at 6:42pm ET.

items.head: Applied Materials +1.3% after hours on Q4 beat
items.body: Beat on Q4 and guided above forecasts (4:27pm). Shares +1.3% at 6:42pm ET.

items.head: Flowers Foods -8.0% after hours on Q3 results
items.body: Reported Q3 results at 4:05pm. Shares -8.0% at 6:38pm ET.

watch.head: PPI, Nov 13 8:30
watch.body: Last producer-price read before the FOMC on Dec 9, with the 10y at 5.10%.

watch.head: S&P Italy rating review, Nov 13
watch.body: BBB+ with a positive outlook since Jan 30. Published after the European close.

watch.head: Retail sales, Nov 17 8:30
watch.body: Next tier-1 consumer read. Empire State survey comes first, Nov 16 8:30.
